-pw8ozEkBzxxrnU8Lwugyg.zh: PAHO針對美洲區發布麻疹疫情警報,今(2026)年美洲區第1-3週共7國報告1,031例確定病例,分別為墨西哥(740例)、美國(171例)、加拿大(67例)、瓜地馬拉(41例)、玻利維亞(10例)、智利(1例)及烏拉圭(1例),較去(2025)年同期(23例)增加43倍,其中73%病患未接種疫苗,11%病患接種史不明,病例主要集中於青少年及青年族群中,另發病率以1歲以下嬰兒為高,其次為1-4歲及5-9歲兒童;去年該地區共計13國報告14,891例確定病例,2024年報告466例,近5年病例數持續增加,且多個國家持續出現疫情。PAHO呼籲各國加強流行病學監測、疫苗接種及緊急疫情防控措施,以阻斷疫情傳播。 歐洲去年共計30國報告7,655例病例,其中8例死亡,病例數以羅馬亞(4,198例)、法國(877例)、荷蘭(534例)、義大利(529例)及西班牙(426例)為多,其中79.9%病患未接種疫苗,病例數以5歲以下年齡層為多(佔40%),ECDC表示去年病例數較2024年(逾3.5萬例)下降,惟仍約2023年病例數兩倍,由於麻疹感染人數通常於冬末春初達到高峰,呼籲民眾檢視自身已完成疫苗接種。 哈薩克今年1月報告1,951例確定病例,病例數以中北部阿斯塔納州(581例)、東南部江布爾州(339例)及東南部阿拉木圖市(317例)為多,其中79%病患未接種疫苗,當局表示拒絕接種疫苗為疫情爆發主因,當局呼籲家長確認孩童疫苗接種情形,並依照國家免疫計畫及時接種疫苗;該國西部阿克托別州疫情嚴峻,單月報告逾百名病例,以3歲以下年齡層為主,其中24例兒童住院治療中。
-pw8ozEkBzxxrnU8Lwugyg.en: PAHO issued a measles outbreak alert for the Americas. In weeks 1–3 of this year, 7 countries in the Americas reported 1,031 confirmed cases: Mexico (740), the United States (171), Canada (67), Guatemala (41), Bolivia (10), Chile (1) and Uruguay (1). This is a 43-fold increase over the 23 cases in the same period last year. Of these cases, 73% were unvaccinated and 11% had unknown vaccination history. Cases were mainly concentrated among adolescents and young adults, and incidence was highest among infants under 1 year, followed by children aged 1–4 and 5–9 years. Last year, 13 countries in the region reported 14,891 confirmed cases, compared with 466 in 2024; cases have continued to increase over the past five years, and many countries continue to report outbreaks. PAHO calls on countries to strengthen epidemiological surveillance, vaccination and emergency outbreak control measures to stop transmission. Europe reported 7,655 cases across 30 countries last year, including 8 deaths. Cases were most numerous in Romania (4,198), France (877), the Netherlands (534), Italy (529) and Spain (426). Of these, 79.9% were unvaccinated, and cases were most numerous among children under 5 years (40%). ECDC said last year's case numbers declined from 2024 (more than 35,000), but remain about twice the 2023 level. Because measles infections usually peak in late winter and early spring, it urges people to check that they have completed their vaccinations. Kazakhstan reported 1,951 confirmed cases in January this year, most in Astana (581), Zhambyl Region in the southeast (339) and Almaty city in the southeast (317). Of these, 79% were unvaccinated. Authorities say refusal of vaccination is the main cause of the outbreak, and urge parents to confirm children's vaccination status and vaccinate them promptly under the national immunization programme. The outbreak is severe in Aktobe Region in the west, which reported more than 100 cases in a single month, mainly among children under 3 years; 24 children are being treated in hospital.

zekEQCwJMOQXY8FKV6j3Lg.zh: 美洲疫情更新,今年截至第30週共11國累計報告12,786例確診病例,其中,巴西11,888例(5例死亡)、巴拿馬501例、秘魯330例、古巴28例、哥倫比亞26例、委內瑞拉5例、蓋亞那1例、烏拉圭3例(境外移入)、智利2例(境外移入)、美國及加拿大各1例(境外移入)。受到氣候變遷等因素導致病媒─帕拉庫蠓孳生,進而造成病毒傳播至非流行地區(如古巴市區)。此外,英國亦報告3例病例,均有巴西旅遊史。去年美洲地區累計報告16,239例確診病例(4例死亡),歐洲地區亦報告30例境外移入病例。
zekEQCwJMOQXY8FKV6j3Lg.en: Americas outbreak update: as of week 30 this year, 11 countries had cumulatively reported 12,786 confirmed cases: Brazil 11,888 (5 deaths), Panama 501, Peru 330, Cuba 28, Colombia 26, Venezuela 5, Guyana 1, Uruguay 3 (imported), Chile 2 (imported), and the USA and Canada 1 each (imported). Climate change and other factors have led to proliferation of the vector, the Culicoides paraensis midge, which has spread the virus to non-endemic areas such as central Havana, Cuba. In addition, the UK reported three cases, all with travel history to Brazil. Last year, the Americas cumulatively reported 16,239 confirmed cases (4 deaths), and Europe also reported 30 imported cases.

ne3BGKWPv3AuwqNUzKaV2A.zh: 斐濟疫情更新,今年迄今累計逾5,100例病例及3例死亡,病例主要分布於該國西部及中部,主要流行型別為DENV-2及DENV-3,今年病例數已高於去年全年2,033例,疫情可能因雨季而持續上升。 烏拉圭今年迄今累計2例本土病例,病例分布於蒙特維多及派桑杜,當局於疫區加強防治措施;該國去年報告1例本土病例,為2020年以來首例本土病例。
ne3BGKWPv3AuwqNUzKaV2A.en: Fiji update: so far this year, more than 5,100 cases and 3 deaths have been reported cumulatively, mainly in the west and centre of the country. The main circulating serotypes are DENV-2 and DENV-3. This year's case count already exceeds the 2,033 cases for the whole of last year, and the outbreak may continue to rise during the rainy season. Uruguay has reported 2 locally acquired cases so far this year, in Montevideo and Paysandú; authorities have strengthened control measures in the affected areas. The country reported 1 locally acquired case last year, its first since 2020.

0PBSZTAmolxRLvuwPHgZTg.zh: 疫情更新:  2024年第47週(11/18-11/24)全球陽性率約13.4%,陽性率以歐洲區(14.4%)、美洲區(9.9%)及非洲區(6.2%)為高。 WHO於12/9發布XEC變異株風險評估,該變異株由第44週(10/28-11/3)的26.9%上升至第47週(11/18-11/24)的36.8%,依目前資料顯示該病毒株免疫逃脫風險較低,現有JN.1或KP.2疫苗可提供保護,與其他變異株相較,並無明顯增加之公共衛生負擔及風險,評估整體風險為低。 美洲區近期整體呈現下降趨勢,惟南美洲東南部地區近期陽性率處高點,近期智利、巴拉圭及烏拉圭疫情處上升趨勢。 日本新增病例數持續上升,第49週(12/2-12/8)新增15,000餘例,較前一週11,900餘例上升,新增住院數亦持續增加。  評估與建議:  全球陽性率近期略升,其中,非洲區、歐洲區及東南亞區略升,其他地區則呈持平或下降趨勢。KP.3.1.1為全球主要流行變異株,XEC變異株占比上升,惟尚未增加疾病嚴重度。WHO表示多數國家已將COVID-19納入常規呼吸道傳染病監測,建議各國提供民眾可負擔及可信賴的檢測、治療及疫苗,維持預警監視系統及持續追蹤變異株趨勢,並向WHO通報疫情資訊及維繫COVID-19期間所建立之基礎設施。
0PBSZTAmolxRLvuwPHgZTg.en: Epidemic update: In week 47 of 2024 (18–24 November), the global positivity rate was about 13.4%, highest in the European Region (14.4%), the Region of the Americas (9.9%) and the African Region (6.2%). On 9 December, WHO issued a risk assessment for the XEC variant: its share rose from 26.9% in week 44 (28 October–3 November) to 36.8% in week 47 (18–24 November). Current data suggest that this virus strain has a low risk of immune escape, that existing JN.1 or KP.2 vaccines can provide protection, and that there is no obvious increase in public health burden or risk compared with other variants; the overall risk is assessed as low. Recently, the Region of the Americas has shown an overall declining trend, but positivity in the south-eastern part of South America is at a high point, and Chile, Paraguay and Uruguay are trending upward. Japan's new cases continued to rise, with over 15,000 new cases in week 49 (2–8 December), up from over 11,900 the previous week, and new hospitalisations also continued to rise. Assessment and recommendations: Global positivity has recently risen slightly, with slight increases in the African, European and South-East Asian regions, and flat or declining trends elsewhere. KP.3.1.1 is the main global circulating variant; the XEC share is rising, but severity has not yet increased. WHO notes that most countries have integrated COVID-19 into routine respiratory infection surveillance, and recommends that countries provide affordable and reliable testing, treatment and vaccines, maintain early warning and surveillance systems, continue tracking variant trends, report epidemic information to WHO, and maintain the infrastructure established during the COVID-19 period.
